title: Performance and Training of Managers in Singapore
what_it_is: Performance and Training of Managers in Singapore

sections.label: WMS survey limitations
sections.summary: The WMS survey is not conducted regularly or on a consistent sample of countries, so other data points and surveys track firms' performance and competitiveness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: While the WMS provides useful data, it also has its limitations like any other survey.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For instance, the WMS survey is not conducted on a regular basis nor on a consistent sample of countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We track the performance of our firms and our economic competitiveness through other data points and surveys instead.

sections.label: Leadership programmes for enterprises
sections.summary: MAS's FSDF co-funds eligible AFLS leadership programmes, and the Government also helps local enterprises through Enterprise Singapore's Enterprise Leadership for Transformation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, the Financial Sector Development Fund (FSDF) administered by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) co-funds eligible leadership programmes under the Asian Financial Leaders Scheme (AFLS) to develop promising Singaporean leaders in acquiring knowledge to navigate the diverse operating environment in the region, as well as leadership competencies in corporate governance, ethics and culture, as well as strategic thinking and execution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition to the sector-specific initiatives I just highlighted, the Government also helps our local enterprises grow their business and leadership capabilities through programmes such as Enterprise Singapore’s Enterprise Leadership for Transformation.

sections.label: Singapore's IMD competitiveness ranking
sections.summary: In 2022, Singapore placed third in the IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook, behind Denmark and Switzerland, but ahead of some WMS-mentioned countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In 2022, Singapore placed third in this IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook behind Denmark and Switzerland, but ahead of some of the countries which the Member mentioned in the WMS survey.

sections.label: ELT onboarding numbers
sections.summary: Since launching ELT in October 2020, more than 400 business leaders from over 300 companies have been onboarded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Maybe I will just update the Member that since we launched ELT in October 2020, we have onboarded more than 400 business leaders from over 300 companies.

sections.label: WMS survey frequency limitations
sections.summary: The WMS is not done yearly from 2004 to 2022 and is snapshots of different countries across that span.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: There is a variety of performance indicators of which managerial competencies is one.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier the WMS has its limitations; they do not do it on a yearly basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, even when you look at 2004 to 2022, they do not do it on a yearly basis; and from what I understand, it is snapshots of different countries across that span.
